# Other section

```{r}
#| label: walk-loop
#| warning: false
#| echo: false

data |>
  filter(Common_name %in% c("petrale sole", "sablefish")) |>
  arrange(Common_name, .locale = "en") |>
	group_by(Common_name) |>
	distinct(Common_name) |>
	pull(Common_name) |>
	as.character() |>
	walk(multiplot)
 
```
